FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.LEAD: Everything you need to know about 42 Bets: how prediction markets work, your account, betting and security.
FAQ.CAT1_A1: 42 Bets is a prediction market platform designed for the 42 community. Each market asks a YES or NO question (for example, "Will 42 open a new campus before the end of 2026?"). You take a position on the answer you think is most likely, and you win if you're right.
FAQ.CAT1_Q2: How does a prediction market work?
FAQ.CAT1_A2: A market reflects the collective probability of an event. The more popular an answer, the less it pays out; an answer considered unlikely pays more if it comes true. When the market closes and the result is known, winning positions are paid out.
FAQ.CAT1_Q3: Do I need an account to use the site?
FAQ.CAT1_A3: Not to browse: the home page and market list are accessible to everyone without logging in. However, to take a position on a market and access your dashboard, you need to create an account and log in.
FAQ.CAT2_Q1: How do I create an account?
FAQ.CAT2_A1: Click "Create an account", enter your email and a password, then confirm your address via the link sent by email. You can also log in with your 42 account (OAuth).
FAQ.CAT2_Q2: Are my data and account secure?
FAQ.CAT2_A2: Yes. Authentication relies on a client-side JWT access token and a refresh token stored in an httpOnly cookie on the server side, which limits session theft risks. Your passwords are never stored in plain text.
FAQ.CAT2_Q3: I forgot my password, what should I do?
FAQ.CAT2_A3: On the login page, click "Forgot password". You will receive an email with a secure link to set a new password.
FAQ.CAT2_Q4: Why do I need a MetaMask wallet?
FAQ.CAT2_A4: 42C is a token that lives on the blockchain: MetaMask is the wallet that actually holds your tokens and signs transactions on your behalf. Without a connected wallet, the platform cannot credit your 42C, record your positions or winnings in a verifiable way. MetaMask lets you remain the owner of your funds and authorize each operation (position purchase, withdrawal) securely, without ever sharing your private key with 42 Bets.
FAQ.CAT3_Q1: How do I take a position on a market?
FAQ.CAT3_A1: Open a market, choose YES or NO, enter the amount in 42C you want to invest, then confirm. The interface shows you in real time the potential gain and the multiplier associated with your position before confirmation.
FAQ.CAT3_A2: 42C is the platform's virtual currency. You use it to take positions on markets and earn it when your predictions are correct. It is an internal currency dedicated to the gaming experience.
FAQ.CAT3_A3: When the market closes, once the actual result has been established. If your position matches the outcome, your winnings (stake + profit) are automatically credited and visible from your dashboard.
FAQ.CAT3_A4: Yes. The dashboard, accessible after logging in, groups your open positions, history, and winnings. You can track the evolution of each of your predictions.
FAQ.CAT4_Q1: Does the game involve real money?
FAQ.CAT4_A1: 42 Bets is a community and entertainment platform based on virtual currency (42C). It aims to engage the 42 community around predictions, not to replace a real-money betting service.
FAQ.CAT4_A2: If you can't find the answer to your question, contact the team via the "Contact us" page. We're here to help.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.INTRO: This privacy policy explains how 42bet processes data related to the use of the platform, including the web interface, authentication, market features, order activity, technical logging, and administration tools.
PRIVACY.S1_P1: This policy applies to data processed when you visit 42bet, create an account, log in, submit orders, use market features, confirm your email, request a password reset, use an OAuth connection, or access restricted views.
PRIVACY.S1_P2: It covers the processing carried out by the 42bet instance used, as well as the technical traces necessary for security, maintenance, and support.
PRIVACY.S2_LI1: Account data: username, email, server-side hashed password, role, email confirmation status, and OAuth information where applicable.
PRIVACY.S2_LI2: Authentication data: access tokens used by the client, session or refresh cookies, login and logout events.
PRIVACY.S2_LI3: Market data: submitted orders, history, order book activity, and associated consents.
PRIVACY.S2_LI4: Technical data: IP address, browser type, environment, pages visited, timestamps, errors, and security logs.
PRIVACY.S2_LI5: Support data: content of messages submitted in case of contact or report.
PRIVACY.S3_LI1: Creating and managing your user account.
PRIVACY.S3_LI2: Authenticating you, protecting restricted routes, and managing roles.
PRIVACY.S3_LI3: Operating core features, including market browsing and order submission.
PRIVACY.S3_LI4: Providing email confirmation, password reset, and OAuth flows.
PRIVACY.S3_LI5: Preventing fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access.
PRIVACY.S3_LI7: Complying with applicable technical, security, and legal requirements.
PRIVACY.S4_P1: Processing is carried out because it is necessary for the operation of the service, the execution of requested features, the protection of the platform, and the proper management of the project. Certain integrations, such as OAuth, involve data exchanges strictly necessary for the chosen flow.
PRIVACY.S5_P1: 42bet uses technical mechanisms (refresh cookies, authentication headers, access tokens, and request data) to maintain your session, protect access points, and detect errors.
PRIVACY.S5_P2: The instance may also log errors, requests, and security events to identify technical incidents or abnormal usage.
PRIVACY.S6_P1: Data is shared only with the components and providers necessary for the project to function (hosting, database, email, OAuth, technical services). 42bet is not a data resale platform.
PRIVACY.S6_P2: Communications may however be necessary for security, audit, technical support, or compliance with a legal obligation.
PRIVACY.S7_P1: Data is retained for the period necessary for account operation, platform security, and incident resolution. Some technical traces may be retained longer for audit and security purposes.
PRIVACY.S7_P2: 42bet implements appropriate technical and organizational measures (access control, authentication, role segregation, password hashing, error monitoring). No internet architecture guarantees absolute security.
PRIVACY.S8_LI1: Request access to data associated with your account.
PRIVACY.S8_LI2: Request the correction of inaccurate information.
PRIVACY.S8_LI3: Request, where possible, the deletion of unnecessary data.
PRIVACY.S8_LI4: Object to certain non-essential processing or request its limitation.
PRIVACY.S8_LI5: Request the closure of your account on the relevant instance.
PRIVACY.S8_P1: To exercise these rights, contact the administrators or managers of the 42bet instance used through the available support channels. Identity verification may be requested before processing.
PRIVACY.S9_P1: The platform is not intended for children. Its use must be reserved for people capable of understanding the implications of an account system and a prediction market interface. The project is part of a 42 framework with an educational purpose.
PRIVACY.S10_P1: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in the product, integrations, logging practices, or applicable obligations. The update date is shown at the top of the page.
